title: Approval review
idea: Approval review: A proposal and its relevant evidence sit beside a clear approve, reject or request-change decision.
audience: People who need to review approval within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: A reviewer must assess consequences and record rationale.
avoidWhen: Approving is presented without necessary permissions or evidence.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its review approval priority and explicit commitment contract: Record the exact proposal version and authoritative decision; prevent stale approval.
navigation: Approval review keeps the current review approval context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A proposal and its relevant evidence sit beside a clear approve, reject or request-change decision.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review approval; a reviewer must assess consequences and record rationale.
composition.priority: Record the exact proposal version and authoritative decision; prevent stale approval.

imagery.role: Support the actual review approval context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Move supporting material into labelled sections before the decision controls.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the approval review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review approval content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Record the exact proposal version and authoritative decision; prevent stale approval.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review approval content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Record the exact proposal version and authoritative decision; prevent stale approval.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review approval context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
